basis: Seed observations that vm/SPEC.md section 8 cites and no golden can carry: the seed fails, its two lanes agree on a form that binds a request as a value and holds no Case, Knot cannot lower the form (the `head` lane is the pinned literals head's check-cli), or the seed's native lane takes a catch-all for which the image has no place (round 13, review round 1: a catch-all beside a table that names every constructor, or reached only through a field pattern; section 3 keeps a Default only where a row is absent, so a compiled plan is a complete table and the VM refuses the request). Each source runs on both seed lanes; the native lane is the reference. The exit and stdout of each lane were reviewed from the probes of the round-11 review, of round 12 and of round 13's review round 1 before `check-spec.py --freeze-new` froze the bytes. Round 13 (D24) promoted the three witnesses of a Case with a Default beside a constructor row over a request to goldens, `case-request-emit-default-u32`, `case-request-halt-default-u32` and `case-request-emit-default`, which the VM must match. A witness is evidence for the text and never a VM expectation.

witnesses.name: main-lambda-print
witnesses.note: main is a bare `R => k => ...`: `IO.print("direct")(R, k)`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-continue
witnesses.note: main = `R => k => k(Unit{})`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'f.j')

witnesses.name: main-lambda-halt
witnesses.note: main = `R => k => Halt{1, "boom"}`. Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-let
witnesses.note: a let-bound dead request beside a bare lambda main (DECISIONS finding 13 as first reported). Both lanes crash.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: main-lambda-nolet
witnesses.note: the same source without the let: the crash is main's form, not the let. Its call-shaped twin with the let is the golden `let-dropped-request`.

bun.stderr: TypeError: s.fun is not a function. (In 's.fun(s.arg)', 's.fun' is an instance of Object)

witnesses.name: case-request-default-only
witnesses.note: `case _: d` over a request: never read, both lanes run and the request is never performed; a lone catch-all holds no Case (D24).

witnesses.name: case-request-binder
witnesses.note: `case y: d` over a request: never read, both lanes run; a binder holds no Case (D24: it binds the request as a value).

witnesses.name: case-request-both-arms
witnesses.note: arms for Emit and Halt over a request: both lanes fail-stop (the seed's own tests/io/request_out_of_band.bend).

witnesses.name: catch-all-lone
witnesses.note: a lone `case _:` over a Flag: the seed runs it, the pinned literals head answers Unsupported check variable-pattern.

witnesses.name: catch-all-binder
witnesses.note: a lone binder `case y:` over a Flag: the same.

witnesses.name: catch-all-after-arm
witnesses.note: `case _:` after a constructor arm over a Flag: the same. The pinned literals head refuses every catch-all on an algebraic type; the pattern matrix of the nest increment accepts them but lowers each into a complete table with no Default, so the Case with a Default over a request is a golden and a rule for hand-written plans (D24, SPEC section 8, DECISIONS entry 37).

witnesses.name: case-request-both-plus-default
witnesses.note: arms for Emit and Halt and a catch-all over a request, printed as a U32: the catch-all is dead for every constructor and live only for a request, so the native lane takes it (`3`) and the Bun lane fail-stops. Section 3 keeps a Default only where a row is absent, so the plan of this source is the table of its two arms, equal to the compiled twin of the golden `case-request-emit-default-u32` (`case-request-emit-default-u32-compiled`), which the VM refuses; that golden's source prints `2`. A recorded gap (SPEC section 8), never a VM expectation.

witnesses.name: case-request-nested-default
witnesses.note: arms for Emit and for Halt whose code is matched against 0, and a catch-all: the outer table names every constructor, so the catch-all is reached only through the field pattern and the native lane takes it for a request (`3`); the Bun lane fail-stops. Where a checker accepts the source (nest at 2a84a4f5 lowers a constructor sub-pattern so; the merged head refuses a `_` after a literal field pattern as `Unsupported check variable-pattern`), the plan is Emit and Halt rows, the Halt row a keys Case on its code with the catch-all as its Default, and no Default at the outer table (`case-request-nested-default-compiled`), which the VM refuses; `case-request-inner-default-only` has the same plan and a native fail-stop. A recorded gap (SPEC section 8).

witnesses.name: case-request-inner-default-only
witnesses.note: the catch-all only inside the Halt arm, as the default of a match on its code, and no outer catch-all: a request matches no arm of the outer Case, so both lanes fail-stop. Its plan is the plan of `case-request-nested-default` (Emit and Halt rows, the Halt row a keys Case on its code with Default 3, no Default at the outer table), whose native value is `3`: two sources, one plan, two native answers, so no rule of the VM can agree with the seed on that plan (`case-request-nested-default-compiled`, SPEC section 8).

witnesses.name: case-request-book-both-plus-default
witnesses.note: the same shape as a Book over a Flag: the native lane takes the catch-all (`On{}`) and the Bun lane prints the unreduced term, a `got` that never reduces. Its plan is a complete table with no Default, which the VM refuses as it refuses `book-print`. A recorded gap (SPEC section 8).
